snippet.title: WRC 3 FIA World Rally Championship - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
WRC 3 marks a radical departure from the previous titles in the series and sees the team using a completely new graphics and game engine - Spike Engine -, developed in-house. There are three main game modes: ROAD TO GLORY, the newly designed career mode, WRC EXPERIENCE that will put the player in a professional rally driver's shoes and WRC ONLINE, the multiplayer mode. The game features all rallies from the 2012 WRC calendar, complete with all 54 leading WRC teams and drivers in the revamped career mode. Milestone has streamlined every aspect of the game to give new players instant gameplay satisfaction, while still allowing experienced rally gamers to explore the game's full range of features and drive a WRC car from the comfort of their own home.

Starting from today, those who buy WRC 3 copy will have the chance to experience Rallye Monte-Carlo's 1964 charm thanks to an exclusive DLC. The Classic Mini Cooper S 1964, that will be included in "Road to Glory" game mode, will redesign and break space/time boundaries by offering this hitherto unseen experience to rally fans. Classic Mini Cooper S 1964 is available for purchase at 1,99€ on PlayStation Network and 160 Microsoft points on XBOX Live
October 2012 for the Xbox 360® video game and entertainment system from Microsoft, PlayStation®3, Windows PC and on 26th October 2012 for PlayStation®Vita and PlayStation®Store.

Eventually, for those who want to buy the digital Windows PC version of the game, you have just to visit the official WRC site - WRC.com -- or to the official game site - Wrcthegame.com -- and follow the "Download it Now" banner. In few simple clicks, thanks to Nexway, you will be able to live the Authentic Rally Experience on your own PC.
www.wrcthegame.com
